source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the kinetic theory of gases (PDF 5-6).

blocks.text: Gases ki kinetic theory gas ke molecules aur un ki harkat ko bayan karti hai. Is theory mein gas ka dabao us ke zarrat ke bartan ki deewaron se takrane se paida hota hai. Yeh theory darja hararat, hajm aur dabao jaisi khasiyatein, aur viscosity, thermal conductivity aur diffusion jaisi muntaqili khasiyatein bhi samjhati hai. Kinetic molecular theory ideal gases par laagu hoti hai aur pichhli class mein bayan ho chuki hai. Is ke bunyadi mafrooze yeh hain:

items: Gas bohat bari tadaad ke nanhe zarrat par mushtamil hai jo apne size ke muqable aik doosre se door door hain.
Gas ke zarrat be-tarteeb simton mein musalsal, tez harkat mein hain.
Gas ke zarrat aur bartan ki deewaron ki takkarein mukammal elastic hain.
Takkar ke ilawa gas ke zarrat ke darmiyan koi kashish ya dhakelne wali quwwat nahi.
Gas ke zarrat ki ausat kinetic energy gas ke darja hararat par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Hawa ke chhote se 'cube' mein 10^20 tak molecules ho sakte hain. Gas ke zarrat ka apna hajm un ke darmiyan khali jagah ke hajm ke muqable na-qabil-e-zikr hai.

blocks.title: Mean free path
blocks.text: Mean free path woh ausat faasla hai jo harkat karta zarra aisi takkar se pehle tay karta hai jo us ki simt ya tawanai ko numayan taur par badal de.

blocks.prompt: Kinetic theory ka kaun sa mafrooza batata hai ke gas apna poora bartan kyun bhar deti hai?
blocks.explanation: Zarrat musalsal, tez, be-tarteeb harkat mein hain aur (takkar ke ilawa) aik doosre ko nahi kheenchte, is liye tamam dastyab jagah mein phail jate hain.

items: Kinetic theory: deewaron se takkar se dabao.
Mafrooze: nanhe door door zarrat, be-tarteeb harkat, elastic takkarein, takkar ke ilawa quwwat nahi, ausat KE T par munhasir.
Mean free path: numayan takkaron ke darmiyan ausat faasla.
